metadata.description: Plugins from the Nutritional Therapy Association for studying and working with NTA's material through NTAI.

plugins.name: nta-student
plugins.description: Study NTA's curriculum with NTAI: a study session that knows where you are, lesson checks and practice with hints before answers, workshop readiness, cited answers, and NTA's scope and integrity rules.

plugins.name: nta-staff
plugins.description: For NTA staff: find and cite what NTA's material says with NTAI, and know what goes to a person.

plugins.name: nta-instructor
plugins.description: For NTA instructors and TAs: learners' progress by learning objective, group summaries, workshop briefs, check-in drafts you send yourself, and practice sets you assign, with NTAI.
